draft.heroMessage: Trusted advisor for your Greater Fort Worth home journey.
draft.welcomeNote: Hi, I’m Sascha Chatman, your dedicated REALTOR® serving Greater Fort Worth and the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Whether you’re buying your first home or selling your current one, I’m here to guide you every step of the way.
draft.tagline: Your Trusted Partner in DFW Real Estate.
draft.aboutParagraph: At Chatman Realty Group, our mission is simple: to equip families and individuals with knowledge, support, and results in every real estate transaction. Since 2017, I have worked to simplify your real estate experience, from market insights to connections with exceptional local service providers. My clients appreciate a patient, professional approach and hands-on support—helping you achieve your goals, whether that’s finding your first home or building your wealth through property. I pride myself on clear communication, a streamlined process, and a passion for helping clients thrive in our fast-growing market.
draft.conciergeLine: Let’s talk about your goals—call or message me anytime, and I’ll help you navigate your next step in the DFW market.
draft.contactLine: Ready to move forward? Reach Sascha at (817) 383-2423 or 817-668-0311 for a personalized consultation.
draft.tone: approachable, informative, and community-focused with an emphasis on education and partnership.

sections.body: Once we've determined the price, I can give you advice about the little things that you can do to stage your home to get you the highest possible price! I have a marketing plan that is designed to get maximum exposure to the buyers that are currently looking, and all agents that have buyers.

items.title: 9652 Calaveras Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76177
items.description: This must-see home is designed for effortless living and entertaining, offering an ideal blend of style, space, and functionality. The main level features a spacious primary suite, a secondary bedroom, and a dedicated office, providing flexibility for guests, work-from-home needs, or multigenerational living. At the heart of the home, the expansive open-concept kitchen, living, and dining areas flow seamlessly together, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, discover two additional bedrooms, a generous game room, and a private media room, offering plenty of room for everyone to relax and enjoy. Step outside to your own private backyard oasis, beautifully enhanced by professional landscaping, a charming pergola, and a stamped-concrete patio. The thoughtfully designed outdoor space provides privacy and an exceptional setting for entertaining, dining, or simply unwinding. With generous living spaces, a highly functional floor plan, and a professionally finished backyard retreat, this home truly has it all.

items.title: 3801 Heather Meadows Dr, Fort Worth, TX 76244
items.description: Set on a corner lot in Heather Meadows, this 2021 brick two-story welcomes you with a long entry hall and luxury vinyl plank floors. Just inside, French doors open to a private office, and a nearby bedroom and full bath give guests their own space. The hall leads to the open heart of the home, where the living room flows into a kitchen with dark cabinetry, granite counters, a large island with breakfast bar, a gas oven, and a walk-in pantry. Tucked away at the back, the primary suite has a ceiling fan, dual sinks, a garden tub, a separate walk-in shower, and a large walk-in closet with built-in shelving. Upstairs, a 16x18 second living area connects two more bedrooms and a full bath. Step out back to a covered patio and a large, fully fenced yard. With 2,990 sq ft, a two-car garage, and Keller ISD schools, this home is vacant and easy to show. Ask about discounted rate options for qualified buyers.

Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, and those needing extra storage will appreciate the oversized 4-car garage with plenty of room for vehicles, tools, and recreational equipment. Combining luxury features, energy-efficient construction, and generous indoor and outdoor living spaces, this exceptional property offers the ideal blend of style, function, and comfort.

items.description: Spacious 3,910 sq. ft. two story home featuring 4 bedrooms, 4 full baths and 2 powder baths.
